insight: Built by two ex-Microsoft engineers; went through Y Combinator (S23).
name: Khoj
tagline: AI second brain that chats with your docs and the web, local or hosted.
description: An open-source "AI second brain" for chatting with local or online models, searching across your personal documents and the internet, building custom agents, and automating research. Self-host it on your own machine, or use plugins for Obsidian, Emacs, desktop, and mobile. Licensed AGPL-3.0; a paid managed cloud tier also exists, so it's freemium.

modelSupport.notes: Local or online models; bring your own API keys.

edge: AGPL second brain that lives inside Obsidian, Emacs, desktop and mobile — self-host over your own notes and the web.
pros: Searches local docs plus the web
cons: AGPL license can deter commercial use
Cloud tier needed for zero-setup use
